name: Mailly
author: cosmicinfosoftware

sections.description:
Stop your WordPress emails from going to spam. Mailly is a professional WordPress SMTP plugin designed to ensure 100% reliable email delivery. By replacing the default PHP mail with secure API integrations or standard SMTP, Mailly connects your site to top-tier services like Gmail, Outlook, Amazon SES, and SendGrid. Whether you’re running a small blog or a high-traffic WooCommerce store, Mailly offers enterprise-level features to optimize your transactional emails. Benefit from real-time Email Tracking (Opens/Clicks), Smart Routing for multiple mailers, Automatic Failover (Backup Connections), and a Detailed Email Log to keep your business communications running perfectly.

Features

⭐ Comprehensive Email Log – Keep a complete record of every email sent, including subject, recipient, status, and precise timestamps for total audit control.
⭐ 15+ Native API Mailers – Connect securely to Gmail, Outlook, Amazon SES, Mailgun, SendGrid, Brevo, and more using native high-performance APIs.
⭐ Intelligent Smart Routing – Create conditional rules to route specific emails (like WooCommerce orders) through different providers based on subject or recipient.
⭐ Automated Failover System – Ensure zero downtime by automatically switching to a secondary backup connection if your primary mailer fails.
⭐ Real-time Open & Click Tracking – Gain valuable insights with instant tracking of email opens and link clicks directly within your WordPress dashboard.
⭐ Bulk & Individual Resend – Effortlessly resend failed emails or duplicate successful ones with a single click, individually or in bulk from the log.
⭐ Asynchronous Dispatching – Boost site performance by offloading email sending to a background queue, preventing slow page loads for users.
⭐ Weekly Performance Digest – Receive a beautiful, automated summary of your email delivery health, success rates, and tracking stats every week.
⭐ Granular Email Controls – Take full control by suppressing specific emails or blocking certain subjects and recipients to avoid unwanted communications.
⭐ Twilio SMS Alerts – Stay informed even when away from your desk with instant SMS notifications via Twilio for critical delivery failures.
⭐ Robust Webhook Integration – Automatically synchronize delivery statuses and tracking events via provider webhooks for 100% data accuracy.
⭐ Secure OAuth2 Authentication – Use the latest security standards to connect with Google, Microsoft, and Zoho without storing sensitive passwords.
⭐ Developer-First Architecture – Highly extendable with a wide array of hooks and filters, allowing for deep custom integrations and behavior modification.
⭐ Interactive Dashboard Widget – Get an at-a-glance overview of your recent email performance and delivery success directly on your WordPress home screen.
⭐ 24/7 Dedicated Support – Our expert technical team is always available to help you with configuration, mailer setup, or troubleshooting.
⭐ One-Click Configuration – Get up and running in seconds with an intuitive interface designed for both beginners and experts.
⭐ Custom Header Support – Easily add custom X-Headers to your emails for better organization and advanced server-side filtering.
⭐ Translation & RTL Ready – Fully compatible with all languages and RTL layouts, perfect for global businesses and websites.
⭐ Optimized for Speed – Lightweight code architecture that handles high email volumes without slowing down your site or server.
⭐ GPL Licensed & Secure – 100% open-source and built with the latest security standards to keep your communication safe.

Supported Mailers & Providers

We support all major providers via native API integrations for maximum speed and security:
* Google / Gmail (Secure OAuth2)
* Microsoft Outlook / Office 365 (Secure OAuth2)
* Zoho Mail (Secure OAuth2)
* Amazon SES
* Mailgun
* SendGrid
* Brevo (formerly Sendinblue)
* Postmark
* SparkPost
* Resend
* MailerSend
* Mailjet
* Elastic Email
* SendLayer
* SMTP.com / SMTP2GO
* Generic SMTP (For any other provider)

External services

This plugin facilitates the sending of emails through various third-party email delivery services (Mailers). When you configure and enable a specific mailer, the plugin will connect to that service’s API to deliver your outgoing WordPress emails.

The following services may be used depending on your configuration:

  • Google (Gmail/Google Workspace): Used to send emails via the Gmail API. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Microsoft (Outlook/Office 365): Used to send emails via the Microsoft Graph API. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Amazon SES: Used to send emails via the Amazon SES API. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Mailgun: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.

  • Postmark: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Resend: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Zoho Mail: Used to send emails via the Zoho API. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Mandrill: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Meta (WhatsApp Business Platform): Used to send WhatsApp alerts and manage templates. It sends alert content, recipient phone numbers, and template names. Terms, Privacy.
  • MailerSend: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Mailjet: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • SparkPost: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Elastic Email: Used to send emails via the Elastic Email API. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • SendLayer: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • SMTP.com: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • SMTP2GO: Used to send emails and receive delivery status webhooks. It sends email content, recipients, and subjects. Terms, Privacy.
  • Twilio: Used to send SMS alerts if configured. It sends alert messages and phone numbers. Terms, Privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mailly folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Mailly in your admin menu to configure your primary connection.
  4. (Optional) Set up Backup Connections or Smart Routing in the respective tabs.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account with an email provider?

Yes, you will need an account (like Mailgun, SendGrid, or a Google Workspace account) to use this plugin effectively.

Can I track clicks and opens?

Absolutely. Enable “Tracking” in the Settings tab to start seeing analytics in your Email Log.

Will this slow down my site?

No. By enabling Asynchronous Dispatch, emails are processed in the background, making your page loads faster.
